status_policy: All seeded expectations start unverified. Code presence, an open PR, and a passing isolated unit test are not release proof. Only reproducible acceptance evidence may set status=verified.

expectations.title: Manual payment proof is scoped to the authenticated owner
expectations.description: A user cannot submit or mutate a pending payment belonging to another account.
acceptance_criteria: Controller passes authenticated user identity to the provider.
Database mutation scopes payment ID, owner ID, pending state and payment method atomically.
Cross-account IDOR regression test fails before fix and passes after fix.

expectations.title: Payment settlement and manual verification are race-safe and idempotent
expectations.description: Retries, duplicate workers and concurrent approve/reject actions cannot create inconsistent wallet/payment state.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent approve/reject has one conditional state transition winner.
Duplicate settlement creates at most one ledger credit.
Crash/retry and worker duplication tests verify durable recovery.
Ledger and payment state reconciliation has no unexplained divergence.

expectations.title: Basket checkout uses real configured destinations
expectations.description: No placeholder checkout hostname or dead legacy payment URL is shipped.
acceptance_criteria: No placeholder domain remains in checkout paths.
Every checkout action targets an implemented and environment-configured backend/web destination.
A device-level checkout smoke test verifies the user journey.

expectations.title: Personality/OCEAN text analysis requires current explicit consent
expectations.description: Consent is checked before processing and again before persisting an assessment; estimates are not silently used for matching.
acceptance_criteria: No LLM call occurs without recorded consent.
Consent revocation during processing prevents persistence.
Assessment records consent version and provenance.
Text-based estimates remain excluded from matching eligibility unless separately approved and validated.

expectations.title: Safety moderation fails closed when required moderation is unavailable
expectations.description: Service outages or malformed moderation responses do not silently allow unsafe actions.
acceptance_criteria: Timeout, connection failure and malformed response cases are tested.
Protected actions are denied or safely held when policy requires moderation.
Mobile and backend contracts agree on blocked/retry states.

expectations.title: Matching events and recommendation attribution are versioned and idempotent
expectations.description: Matching decisions can be traced from event ingestion to impressions and user feedback.
acceptance_criteria: Event schema is versioned and validated.
Duplicate event delivery is idempotent.
Recommendation IDs connect impression to like/dislike/skip outcomes.
Hard constraints are tested independently from ranking quality.

expectations.title: Revenue analytics use real ledger facts and reproducible provenance
expectations.description: Revenue, LTV and product/gender breakdowns are derived from actual purchase and ledger facts, not synthetic defaults.
acceptance_criteria: Missing input features remain missing rather than receiving fabricated defaults.
Every metric exposes source, time window and missingness/provenance.
Historical gender attribution uses purchase-time snapshot.
Reconciliation matches source transactions and wallet ledger.

expectations.title: Admin revenue endpoints are registered and currency filters reach the backend
expectations.description: Admin UI and backend expose the same revenue contract and selected currency is applied server-side.
acceptance_criteria: Revenue controller is registered in the running module graph.
Currency and date filters reach the backend query.
Contract tests verify response types and empty/error states.
A real non-production database smoke test verifies totals.

expectations.title: Admin authentication is usable and securely provisioned
expectations.description: Admin login, password setup, session handling and bootstrap do not depend on insecure public seeding.
acceptance_criteria: Login form submits through the intended API path.
Password setup and session refresh work end-to-end.
No default credential or unauthenticated seeder is exposed.
Unauthorized admin APIs reject access.

expectations.title: Mobile test suite and lint baseline are release-gated
expectations.description: The mobile repository can run deterministic tests and a clean lint gate on the current head commit.
acceptance_criteria: Full Jest suite passes on current PR head.
Lint has zero errors and explicitly budgeted warnings.
CI reports the exact commit SHA and test counts.
A failed gate blocks release readiness.

expectations.title: Release APK is reproducible, signed and install-smoke-tested
expectations.description: Release artifact is built from the reviewed commit with a verified signature and install/launch checks.
acceptance_criteria: APK SHA-256 and source commit SHA are recorded.
Production signing certificate identity is verified without exposing private keys.
Install, launch, login and critical journey smoke tests pass.
Artifact is clearly distinguished as test or production-signed.

expectations.title: Mobile, backend, admin and database contracts are traceable end-to-end
expectations.description: Every critical user journey has a verified chain across client, endpoint, authorization, service, persistence and admin visibility.
acceptance_criteria: Critical journeys have named acceptance scenarios and correlation IDs.
Each API call maps to a backend route and persistence behavior.
Authorization and failure states are tested at integration level.
Admin observability and financial/safety side effects reconcile to source records.
